reading.zh: 先看 catalog（数据层：香蕉网访问、各种缓存、图片缓存），再看 tasks（纯整形，下载页与侧栏徽标共用）。数据层不替用户下载文件。
reading.en: Catalog is the data layer (GameBanana access, caches, image cache); tasks is the pure shaping that both the downloads page and the sidebar badge read. The data layer never downloads files for the user by itself.
